title: Tall bookcase
summary: A tall plywood bookcase for a child's bedroom, with a light under the top shelf.
priceNote: Example prices from a UK DIY store.

steps.title: Cut the parts
do: Mark each part on the plywood from the cut list.
Cut each part on the waste side of the line.
Write the part letter on each part.
steps.check: Make sure that you have two sides A, five shelves B and one back C.

steps.title: Sand the parts
do: Sand all faces and edges with 120 grit.
Remove the dust with a dry cloth.
steps.check: Make sure that no saw marks show on the edges.

steps.title: Attach the bottom shelf to the left side
do: Put side A on its back edge on the floor.
Hold shelf B against the side, 60 mm above the bottom end.
Drill three pilot holes through the side into the shelf.
Install three screws.
steps.check: Make sure that the shelf is at 90 degrees to the side.

steps.title: Attach the top shelf
do: Align the top face of shelf B with the top end of the side.
Drill three pilot holes.
Install three screws.
steps.check: Make sure that the top shelf is flush with the top end of the side.

steps.title: Attach the right side
do: Put the second side A on the free ends of the two shelves.
Drill three pilot holes into each shelf.
Install six screws.
steps.check: Make sure that the two sides are parallel.

steps.title: Attach the middle shelves
do: Mark the shelf lines at 480, 900 and 1320 mm from the bottom end of each side.
Put each shelf B on its lines.
Drill three pilot holes through each side into each shelf.
Install the screws.
steps.check: Make sure that each shelf is level.

steps.title: Attach the back
do: Put the bookcase on its front edges on the floor.
Measure the two diagonals of the frame.
Put back C on the frame.
Install a screw every 300 mm along each side and each shelf.
steps.check: Make sure that the two diagonals are equal within 2 mm.

steps.title: Apply the oil
do: Apply a thin coat of oil with a cloth.
Wait 12 hours.
Apply the second coat.
steps.check: Make sure that the oil is dry before you put books on the shelves.

steps.title: Install the light
do: Attach the light under the top shelf with the two screws in the kit.
Run the cable down the back of the bookcase to the light switch by the door.
Connect the cable to the terminals of the light switch.
steps.check: Make sure that the light comes on at the switch.
